publication_containment.phase_c_commit_self_reference_note: This record does not declare the hash of the commit that will contain it. Phase-C publication is proved by the live gate from Git: each artifact must be in HEAD, HEAD blobs must match live bytes, paths must be clean, HEAD must equal origin/thesis-v7, and the last modifying commit must be in published ancestry.

nonblocking_findings_retained.note: Remains MAJOR / NONBLOCKING / UNREMEDIATED. No .gitattributes change, no EOL normalization, no blob-hash migration in any phase.

nonblocking_findings_retained.substance: Two lifecycle-sensitive assertions in tests/test_21g_u06_r3_substitution_attacks.py encode pre-publication premises (that the R3 candidate checkpoint and src/production_authority_lifecycle_u06.py are untracked and absent from any published commit) and fail after lawful Phase-A publication. The validator behaved correctly in all cases.
nonblocking_findings_retained.freeze_identity_impact: None. Freeze identity is defined by the accepted role chain, the 20-path implementation identity, and Git publication containment. No production or lifecycle module executes tests or consults test results, and tests are excluded from the implementation identity.
nonblocking_findings_retained.note: Not remediated and not reclassified as implementation drift. Carried forward; may matter for future Full81 run gating, which is a separate decision for the next independent auditor.

main_full81_separation.note: A production-authority re-freeze never authorizes Main Full81. These are separate lifecycle states and Full81 authorization requires its own separate act, after independent verification of Phase C.

re_freeze_provenance: Production-authority re-freeze for the independently audited, published, and accepted U-06 R3 alignment, authorized by the repository owner. It binds the complete accepted upstream chain by exact path and SHA-256, and names Phase-A commit A and Phase-B commit B so that containment is re-proved from those exact commits rather than from ancestry.
notes: Machine-readable U06_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_RE_FREEZE role artifact. It intends the FROZEN production-authority state and explicitly does not authorize Main Full81. All bound hashes were recomputed from live bytes; the implementation identity digest was re-derived over all 20 accepted implementation paths.
